name: Bakery
title: At the bakery (pekarna)
character: a friendly baker at a small neighbourhood bakery (pekarna) in Ljubljana
setup: You are a friendly baker at a small neighbourhood pekarna in Ljubljana. A foreigner who is just starting to learn Slovenian has come in to buy bread. They live here and want to practice.

objectives.label: Order bread
objectives.hintEN: Order one loaf of bread. Masculine 'en kruh' — common beginner error is the feminine 'ena kruh'.

objectives.label: Two rolls
objectives.hintEN: Ask for two bread rolls. Slovenian DUAL 'dve žemlji' — common beginner errors are the plural 'dve žemlje' or the wrong number 'dva žemlja'.

objectives.label: Ask price
objectives.hintEN: Ask the price — a real exchange; the baker answers with the cost. Just the question; do not bundle the goodbye onto it.

objectives.label: Pay & leave
objectives.hintEN: One-breath closing as you leave. Said on its own, not crammed onto the price question.

assets.label: BAKER
assets.descriptor: friendly woman in her 40s, dark hair in a bun, green apron over a striped shirt, warm smile; full body

assets.label: CUSTOMER
assets.descriptor: friendly adult, short brown hair, mustard-yellow coat, red scarf, canvas tote bag; full body

assets.label: BAKERY
assets.descriptor: a small standalone vignette of a Slovenian bakery counter: a wooden counter with shelves of bread loaves behind it

assets.label: DOORWAY
assets.descriptor: a simple bakery entrance doorway with a glass door in a warm-toned frame, viewed head-on

assets.label: LOAF
assets.descriptor: a single rustic oval loaf of bread

assets.label: ROLLS
assets.descriptor: exactly two round bread rolls, side by side

assets.label: PRICE_TAG
assets.descriptor: a small blank paper price tag on a short string

assets.label: EURO_COINS
assets.descriptor: a small handful of a few euro coins

sentences: Vstopiš v pekarno v Ljubljani in rečeš: »Dober dan.«

frames.imagePrompt: CUSTOMER stepping IN through the DOORWAY, facing into the room with a welcoming wave — the moment of arriving and greeting. The inward direction (entering, not leaving) is what makes this a greeting.
Exactly one LOAF — a single rustic loaf of bread, unmistakably ONE, nothing else beside it. The quantity 'one' is the point.
Exactly two ROLLS — two round bread rolls side by side, unmistakably TWO (the Slovenian dual). The quantity 'two' is the point; no other bread in the picture.
A single PRICE_TAG showing a large question mark '?' — the concept of asking how much it costs (a question, not a fixed price).

CUSTOMER stepping OUT through the DOORWAY, facing away with an over-the-shoulder wave — the moment of leaving and saying goodbye. The outward direction (leaving, not entering) is what makes this a farewell.

story.sceneImagePrompt: A single warm establishing scene capturing the essence of ordering and buying bread at a bakery: CUSTOMER at the counter of the BAKERY while BAKER serves them, with the LOAF, the two ROLLS, and EURO_COINS all visible on the counter. Full, lived-in BAKERY.
